scope.exclusions: Artificial host visitors and controllers are separate; deaths, inactive copies and brief escapees do not become leisure residents.

after.description:
Hale controls human behavior and turns the cities into entertainment for hosts. Humans continue performing assigned routines and roles, so being maintained inside a technologically organized environment does not mean they have stopped working. The guarantee best guess is very weak because continued support and safety depend on an unaccountable controller. Ordinary food and shelter may still be supplied; the central point concerns the absence of a secure claim against lethal or coercive decisions.

 Authority lies near autonomous machine control, with humans unable to direct the systems governing their lives. The low nonworking scenario counts assigned performance, service duties and useful care as work, even when the controller could technically dispense with some of them. The share of people following scripts is not itself a leisure statistic. Broad intervals preserve uncertainty about offscreen households. This is a zero variant within captive human cities, separate from the earlier Delos business, Rehoboam’s opportunity system and the active host refuge in the Sublime.

after.name: Humans (Britain before Day Zero)

scope.continuity: British series only; separate from Real Humans
scope.population: Living humans in the depicted British service economy
scope.exclusions: Conscious synth workers are acknowledged as persons where applicable; no general public guarantee or settled post-awakening sovereignty is imported.

after.description:
Synths replace menial tasks and provide purchased domestic care, placing labor-saving machines inside an ordinary consumer economy. The Hawkins household demonstrates an actual service relationship without establishing that all British residents can obtain the same support. The guarantee best guess therefore assumes substantial purchase dependence with room for existing public support. It does not invent an unconditional robot dividend, and a displaced worker is not assumed to receive nothing at all.

 Human firms, buyers and institutions normally direct deployment, giving partly dispersed private control with concentrated corporate influence. Early conscious synth agency qualifies that relationship without making Britain an established AI sovereign state. The moderate nonworking scenario allows displacement and supported leisure while counting continuing professions, care, household help for others and useful informal activity. A robot’s chores or sales figures do not measure people. These broad estimates describe the pre-Day Zero service order; the later awakening changes who is doing the work and receives its own scoped comparison.

guarantees.basis: Purchased care suggests access through resources rather than a new universal dividend; ordinary public support remains possible.

control.basis: Human companies and buyers retain normal service command, with independent conscious agency disclosed as a qualification.

Day Zero turns a labor-saving product population into an openly conscious person population. The later communities face conflict and insecure access while new unconscious orange-eyed models continue commercial service. Awakening is not the same as economic emancipation or a settled welfare constitution. The weak guarantee best guess assumes that active conscious synths must maintain access to power, parts and safety under substantial outside pressure rather than receiving an unconditional continuation right.

 Human institutions still constrain them, while community members gain practical agency over some local arrangements. The central control point therefore remains near concentrated outside human authority, with a wide interval allowing much stronger synthetic independence. The low nonworking scenario counts repairs, community maintenance, care-like work and other ongoing roles among active persons. It is not inferred from the awakening total. This is a synthetic-person zero variant about the persistence and recognition of labor, not an assertion that conscious robots automatically enjoy leisure. Dormant bodies and unconscious replacements do not enlarge its denominator.

scope.continuity: Original Swedish television series only; not the British adaptation
scope.population: Living biological human residents in the depicted Swedish economy
scope.exclusions: Conscious hubots are acknowledged as working persons and excluded from the literal human count; no British-series events are imported.

after.description:
Hubots perform work in an alternative Sweden where access to labor-saving service remains connected to resources and ownership. Their presence changes ordinary households and jobs without proving that every human has an unconditional right to the output. The guarantee best guess allows a meaningful public floor alongside unequal private service access, with a wide interval because the plot reference does not supply an economic charter. A familiar national setting is not itself proof of any particular fictional benefits policy.

 Human owners, employers and institutions retain substantial authority, while conscious hubots challenge the status of property. The control point favors partly dispersed private agency rather than equal collective ownership or completed machine rule. The moderate nonworking scenario counts professions, care, useful household contribution and informal activity despite task replacement. Hubot numbers do not provide the human denominator, and their conscious labor is not erased. This zero variant stays inside the original Swedish continuity rather than borrowing the British adaptation’s awakening, camps or later institutions.

after.reason: Completed comparison: the Entity is an electrical life form defending its home, not established manufactured labor or an implemented technological recipient economy.
after.analysis:
The encountered Entity responds defensively to what it perceives as an invasion of its home. Electrical embodiment does not establish artificial manufacture, a human-derived identity or a system that replaces the labor of a beneficiary population. The episode is useful for distinguishing unusual life from an automatic post-work classification. The earlier hold is therefore replaced by a completed comparison rather than a request for deeper reading.

 Broad coordinates are supplied as an explicitly hypothetical community scenario: middling guarantees, partly distributed person authority and an uncertain nonworking share. None is a canonical claim about the Entity’s home economy. In particular, electrical existence is not counted as automatic provision, and a defensive act is not a census of ongoing occupations. The comparison stays outside the target because the depicted mechanism is contact and self-defense rather than labor substitution or a technological support arrangement. No AI dictatorship or leisure population is invented from the being’s ability to use computers.
after.follow_up: Completed current-policy comparison; no further deep reading required for the depicted contact-versus-provision distinction.
